items.title: Jimmy Owens interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: And I mentioned that to Quincy a couple of weeks ago. He was in New York. And I reminded him, I said, “Hey man, you still owe me an interview.”

ctx.x: You missed getting in the book. Yeah.
And I mentioned that to Quincy a couple of weeks ago. He was in New York. And I reminded him, I said, “Hey man, you still owe me an interview.”
Yeah, well I got it first. That’s a great story, and it’s especially wonderful because I thought that was one of the great bands of all time with Coltrane and Cannonball.
